title: Skibidi Toilet
blurb: Launched in February 2023 by Alexey Gerasimov — better known online as DaFuq!?Boom! — Skibidi Toilet turned a Source Filmmaker gag about singing heads in lavatories into the defining franchise of Gen Alpha. The chant itself is stitched from Biser King's 'Dom Dom Yes Yes' and a Timbaland hook, which explains why it lodges in your skull after exactly one listen. Whatever your stance on brainrot, the view counts settled that argument years ago. Play it to summon every child within two miles, alarm anyone over thirty, or simply file a historical document of the 2020s internet.
origin: From DaFuq!?Boom!'s Skibidi Toilet series, the defining Gen Alpha meme franchise.
